cite.quote: On June 6, 1944, the Allies invaded German-occupied France

summary.text: The landing beach between Utah and Gold, on the coast from west of Sainte-Honorine-des-Pertes to east of Vierville-sur-Mer. The US 29th Infantry Division, with attached Rangers, assaulted the western half and the 1st Infantry Division the eastern half. The objective was a beachhead between Port-en-Bessin and the Vire linking the British at Gold with the US landing at Utah. It was the most heavily defended of the five beaches and had the highest casualties.
